surfaceMapping.basis: GLB inspection identifies mesh 0 as the original placket-button group, meshes 1-5 as source shirt-fabric group, and mesh 6 as the two added cuff fasteners. Existing UV islands overlap across some mesh groups, so each fabric mesh receives an independent texture with matched phase/frequency.

placement.stripeAxis: parallel to UV V on body/sleeve fabric islands; stripe bands vary across U
placement.surfaceExtent: all shirt fabric surfaces, front/back/sleeves; buttons unpatterned
placement.uvPolicy: Preserve source geometry, transforms, topology, and all original UV accessors. Each fabric mesh gets its own texture so overlapping atlas islands cannot overwrite one another.

fabricMeshProfiles.region: right sleeve and collar fabric islands
front body left half and back yoke

textureRaster.uvVOrigin: top-left interpretation used by glTF browser sampling
